payload.summary: Found while writing the repro for 0k83q678: test-baseline.sh (and test-current.sh) interpolate $TEST_CMD into the output-JSON heredoc without escaping double quotes — a test command containing double quotes yields invalid JSON (observed: "test_cmd": "bash -c "printf ...""). Failure lines ARE escaped (sed s/\"/\\\"/g) but the test_cmd field is not. Repro: pass any test cmd containing a double quote, parse the resulting test-baseline.json.
